Processing
Public Domain Project FLAC supplied to Commons; streamed here through the Commons MP3 derivative. Documented

No speed correction, restoration settings or transfer date are stated. The final non-musical tail is excluded only from alignment, not from the supplied stream.

[1] [2]
Composition rights
Handel’s underlying composition is out of copyright under the ordinary life-plus-70 term. Inferred, not documented

The composition-only PD-old-70 tag does not license this 1926 sound recording.

[1]
Recording rights
territorial — European recording-rights expiry; first publication documented before 1963. Documented

Programme rule 3. The upstream record says 1926; the Commons import says 1927. Either date places the recording before the 1963 cutoff. US public-domain status is not established. The upstream page was inspected over HTTP after HTTPS failed; it contains a public-domain claim and no non-commercial restriction. Its asserted worldwide/US expiry dates are not adopted.
